claims: Gary Woodland underwent successful brain surgery in September 2023 to remove a benign lesion that was causing severe fear and anxiety symptoms.
In May 2023, a lesion was discovered on Gary Woodland's brain.
The lesion was pressing on the area responsible for controlling fear and anxiety.
On Sept. 19, 2023, Gary Woodland underwent a craniotomy to remove the tumor.
Doctors were able to remove a majority of the tumor.
Some of the tumor was left to prevent potential loss of sight or motor function on Gary Woodland's left side.
Gary Woodland returned to competition at the Sony Open in Hawaii in January 2024.
Gary Woodland revealed a PTSD diagnosis in March 2026 stemming from the ordeal.
Gary Woodland won the 2026 Houston Open.
The 2026 Houston Open was Gary Woodland's first title since the surgery.
Gary Woodland received the PGA Tour’s Courage Award in February 2025.
